notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing a quick post to let you know I've uploaded a new build of [i]Idleness[/i]! This build fixes a handful of typos which were pointed out by eagle-eyed readers on my Discord server, and I've also added a Mac build to the game.

As always, please let me know if you find any bugs or spelling errors in this new build, and I'll try to fix things in a timely manner. Thank you!

- ebi x
